proposed_widenings.name: level_gated_grant
proposed_widenings.justification: The Fiend Spells feature grants spells in four tiers keyed to warlock level (3, 5, 7, 9) within a single class feature record. PassiveMechanics.grants is a flat EffectAtom array with no per-grant class-level predicate. There is no existing EquipmentPredicate or other gate that expresses 'this grant activates only when class level >= N'.
proposed_widenings.evidence:
| Warlock Level | Spells |
|---|---|
| 3 | Burning Hands, Command, Scorching Ray, Suggestion |
| 5 | Fireball, Stinking Cloud |
| 7 | Fire Shield, Wall of Fire |
| 9 | Geas, Insect Plague |

notes: The L3 tier (Burning Hands, Command, Scorching Ray, Suggestion) encodes cleanly as four grant_spell_access atoms with mode='prepared' in a passive mechanic, and the trace is clean. The L5/L7/L9 spell tiers are intentionally omitted: the surface has no mechanism to express per-grant class-level gates within a single PassiveMechanics record. The widening needed is a class-level predicate on individual grants (or a new ThresholdTiers-style grant-list scaling variant). This is a common 5e 2024 pattern for subclass spell lists.
